alloy.preparation: Type 316LN commercial wrought 2.5 mm sheet cold rolled to 1 mm, cut into 25 × 15 × 1 mm coupons, sealed in silica tubes under He, solution annealed at 1100 °C for 20 min and water quenched. SS wire spot welded and insulated with PTFE, mounted in epoxy, ground with 600-grit emery then diamond polished scratch-free. Thin lacquer at mount interface minimizes crevices; about 3 cm² exposed.

test_solution.preparation: Pure analytical-reagent chemicals in double-distilled water; deaerated by purified H2 bubbling before and during each polarization experiment. pH adjusted using a pH meter, but an individual numerical pH for this registered condition is not specified.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell similar to Greene design, SCE reference and two smooth Pt auxiliary electrodes; potentiostat with strip-chart current/potential recording and current integrator. Tests at unquantified room temperature. Immersed at OCP for 5 min; potential increased anodically in 20 mV steps and current read after 1 min at each potential. At least duplicate runs, pitting-potential variation within 20 mV. No sweep rate calculated from steps and waits.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Abrupt increase in current when the set potential reaches Ep; pitting confirmed by optical microscopy.

experiments.result_note: Table 1 bulk wt% chemistry is retained: explicit Fe 64.23 for 316LN; Fe balance column for 316L, without calculating a residual. Cu dash is unknown, not zero. Dissolved corrosion-product and AES surface compositions do not replace alloy chemistry. H2 is conditioning gas, not a solute; no numerical room temperature, pH or chloride concentration is calculated. Scan/hold difference and source grouping remain explicit.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell similar to Greene design, SCE reference and two smooth Pt auxiliary electrodes; potentiostat with strip-chart current/potential recording and current integrator. Tests at unquantified room temperature. Electrode introduced into solution and held at selected constant potential while current and total charge recorded. Applied-potential grid includes 0 to +700 mV SCE in 100 mV spacings, plus OCP and −260 mV controls; these are fixed-potential exposures rather than the 20 mV/1 min scan method. At +100/+200/+300 mV all metastable pits repassivated within 7–9 h; at +400 and +700 mV stable pitting occurred without current transients. Exposure lengths vary; no single duration is forced into step_hold_duration.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Minimum imposed potential required for stable pit initiation and growth. Persistent pitting at +400 mV, compared with repassivation at +300 mV, supports the registered >300/≤400 mV bracket; metastable-current spikes alone are not stable-pitting onset.

experiments.result_note: Stable pitting supported at +400 mV (SCE); at +300 mV pits repassivated within the test. Retained bracket >300 and ≤400 mV for this hold protocol; distinct from +500 mV polarization-scan result.
